note: Each run is one full Terminal-Bench 2.1 pass with fast-agent: 89 tasks x 5 attempts = 445 trials. Scores are the published figure where a run was published (leaderboard submission or the fast-agent benchmarks page), otherwise the raw mean reward of the primary jobs. Monthly picks hold effort constant where possible (Sol: high; Luna: max, except November where only a medium run exists) rather than taking the best score regardless of effort.
costBasis: List-price equivalent, not money spent. costUsd is the sum of Harbor-recorded per-trial cost at the token rates configured for that run (see costMethod); most runs were billed through Codex or Copilot subscriptions or the OpenAI flex tier, and no invoice figures were used. costUsdRepriced (published October runs only) is bench-run's per-call reprice that charges prompt-cache writes at 125% of input. costUsdStandardList reprices every run's total tokens at one table, the standard-tier under-272k rates in the card-packs pricing catalog 2026-11-05.1 (uncached input, cached input, output; no cache-write or long-context surcharge), so it isolates token use and per-model list price from tier and configuration differences.
